in_marathi.name: Mahen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahen is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahana', which means 'great' or 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, Mahen is a name for the moon god, Chandra. He is the god of the night, responsible for the tides and the cycle of the moon. Mahen is also believed to be a symbol of fertility and prosperity.
